name: Scorpio Tankers
verdict: OWNABLE — 0.40% leg of the 1.25% Hormuz-drip sleeve (ONE bet, class-sliced)
mechanics: LR2/products: TC5 WS528 rising on TWO stacked drivers — the Hormuz leg (MEG product exports + rerouting) AND an independent refining-margin/East-West-arb leg with no strait dependence. The de-coupled leg = the best correlation-reducer in the sleeve; part of the torque survives a full reopening. Cost: 2.4% yield (thin carry).
kill_triggers: SHARED SLEEVE KILL (exit FRO+STNG+LPG together): one week with transits >40/day AND AWRP <0.4% AND TD3C <$60k — all three concurrently; single legs = noise
time-stop: Q2 prints ~Aug + the Aug-31 transit adjudication

edge_explainer.market_believes: The June deal ended the tanker trade — every strait name round-tripped.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The reopening plateaued at a third of normal while rates still print at multiples of it; this name adds a product-tanker leg whose rate strength partly survives even a full reopening to the same underlying position.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Same as FRO: attention to the weekly physical tape vs a market that closed the episode in five sessions. Crowded complex — sleeve-capped accordingly.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: 60% our own number that the strait substantially reopens by Aug-31 — the cushion (price at/near pre-episode) is what makes that survivable.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Weekly transits + premia; Q2 prints ~Aug; Aug-31 adjudication.
edge_explainer.edge_type: drip-sleeve leg; ladder staged, user submits
